protocol.scope: Bounded mathematical audit; no promotion to B1; independent WZZT L1 reference
protocol.prefix_rule: For each of the three single-node early patterns, append one fixed observed batch and update B only by the observed WZZT proposal. Include every prefix, even if no new data are needed.
protocol.response_integration: Exact finite distribution; no new Monte Carlo sample or statistical confidence claim
protocol.lambda_interpretation: Weight on the same future observations, not physical load amplitude or an optimized policy parameter; compare only within the same lambda
protocol.hypothesis_scope: Original complete support enumeration and one deduplicated historical LP representative per family; not all compatible parameters
protocol.parameter_bounds: Nonnegative only, zero allowed, no added upper bounds
protocol.actual_evaluation: After locking all designs, evaluate one next proposal and continue greedy selection until data-based stop; count remaining true positive blocks and full effective support recovery. True support never enters design.
protocol.parameter_face_dual_diagnostic: Record alpha and lambda*alpha<=1, direct dual-vector feasibility, candidate loss intervals, any strictly separated numerical winner, and comparison with exact refit. Floating-point diagnostics, not topology certificates.
protocol.failure_policy: Retain failed cases and pattern rows; do not drop weights or silently use fallback scores
protocol.gate: Reject finite-batch proxy if candidate/menu ranking reverses. Do not promote without actual target-block or runtime advantage versus D-opt and no-new-data.
protocol.reproducibility: Freeze source/config hashes and environment; exclusive lock, immutable design before evaluation, per-phase case checkpoints; new directory after source change
